none: PAS WMID-5D4936: Roman: Complete strap slide / fitting
contea di ritrovamento: Staffordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete copper alloy strap fitting or strap slide, of Early Roman dating (1st to 3rd Century AD). The 'strap-slide' has a square-headed and thin platform/ head with slightly irregular and uneven edges. A thin inscribed line running around the edge is the only decoration on the front of the slide. Stratchmarks are present on the front. The underside of this platform is flat and undecorated.…
